nodes.description: Owner address of the Owned contract; set to msg.sender in the constructor and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Pending owner address; written in transferOwnership and consumed/cleared in acceptOwnership.
Public token symbol string, set to 'WMOB' in the constructor.
Public token name string, set to 'WORLDMOBILITY' in the constructor.
Public token decimals (9), fixed at construction time.
Total token supply, minted to the hardcoded deployer address in the constructor.
Mapping(address=>uint) of token balances; mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping of allowances; written by approve/approveAndCall and decremented by transferFrom.
Checked addition helper; requires the result to be >= a to guard against overflow.
Checked subtraction helper; requires b <= a to guard against underflow.
Checked multiplication helper; requires a == 0 || c / a == b.
Checked division helper; requires b > 0 to avoid division by zero.
Ownership constructor assigning owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner into newOwner.
Two-step ownership acceptance; requires msg.sender == newOwner, emits OwnershipTransferred and resets newOwner.
Initializes symbol/name/decimals/totalSupply and pre-mints the whole supply to a hardcoded address.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Constant view returning balances[tokenOwner].
Moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' and decrements the caller's allowance using safeSub.
Constant view returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets the allowance then performs an external call to spender.receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data).
Payable fallback that immediately reverts, refusing plain ETH transfers.
onlyOwner rescue function performing an external call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens).
Caller-controlled address; used as owner initializer, authorization check and as an index into balances/allowed.
Addition c = a + b performed inside safeAdd.
Subtraction c = a - b performed inside safeSub.
Multiplication c = a * b performed inside safeMul.
Division c = a / b performed inside safeDiv.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed after state update, enabling reentrant callback into the token.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary owner-supplied token contract.

edges.reason: Owned constructor writes owner from msg.sender.
transferOwnership stores the pending owner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with newOwner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
WORLDMOBILITY constructor sets symbol.
WORLDMOBILITY constructor sets name.
WORLDMOBILITY constructor sets decimals.
WORLDMOBILITY constructor mints _totalSupply.
WORLDMOBILITY constructor assigns the entire supply into balances of the hardcoded address.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
transfer reads and writes balances.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom debits balances[from] and credits balances[to].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
safeAdd executes c = a + b.
safeSub executes c = a - b.
safeMul executes c = a * b.
safeDiv executes c = a / b.
transfer calls safeSub on the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd on the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub on balances[from] and on the allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd on balances[to].
owner is initialized directly from the untrusted msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before staging a new owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner to take ownership.
onlyOwner modifier gates the arbitrary-token rescue call on msg.sender.
msg.sender is used as the index into balances in transfer.
msg.sender is used as the index into allowed in approve and transferFrom.
transfer derives the debited account from msg.sender.
approve derives the allowance owner from msg.sender.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is decremented.
approveAndCall sets the allowance for msg.sender and passes it to the callback.
approveAndCall performs an external call into the spender contract, which can re-enter the token before the caller finishes.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call into an arbitrary token contract (owner-gated).

Parameter b flows into the checked addition of safeAdd.

Parameter b flows into the checked subtraction of safeSub.
Parameter a flows into the checked multiplication of safeMul.
Parameter b flows into the checked multiplication of safeMul.
Parameter a flows into the checked division of safeDiv.
Parameter b flows into the checked division of safeDiv.
tokenOwner parameter selects the balance slot read by balanceOf.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping.
to parameter receives the credited balance in transfer.
tokens parameter is the amount debited and credited in transfer.
spender parameter indexes allowed in approve.
tokens parameter is the allowance value written by approve.
from parameter is the debited account in transferFrom.
to parameter is the credited account in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the moved amount in transferFrom.
tokenOwner parameter indexes allowed in allowance.
spender parameter indexes allowed in allowance.
spender parameter receives the allowance and is the callback target.
tokens parameter is the allowance set in approveAndCall.
data parameter is accepted by approveAndCall for forwarding.
data parameter is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval callback.
tokenAddress parameter is used by the rescue function.
tokens parameter is passed to the external token transfer.
tokenAddress parameter becomes the target of the external contract call.
_newOwner parameter is stored into newOwner by transferOwnership.
